documents.title: Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors - Transcript
Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited reported financial and operational results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, showing revenue and export growth alongside capacity expansion initiatives. Management outlined strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up cast aluminium wheels, wind energy components, hydraulic cylinders, and air suspension business. Capex for FY27 is estimated to be between Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores, funded predominantly through accruals while holding debt at current levels. Wheels India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with standalone gross revenues of Rs 1,386.07 crs and consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 crs. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
